class.name: SteamIdentity
class.brief_description: A Steam identity verified by a trusted publisher scope.
class.description: Use the identity returned by [method SteamPublisherAuth.verify] when calling trusted services. A manually created value carries no verification and cannot authorize an action. The original publisher scope must remain active.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Full canonical decimal SteamID64 authenticated by Valve.

method.name: get_license_owner_steam_id
method.description: Full decimal license owner SteamID64 when Valve supplies it. Empty when omitted.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Steamworks AppID used to verify the ticket.
